title: Readiness PO layer: VerdictCards, QuestionCards grouped by source span, intent-complete empty state, For-engineers DocRow
description: `renderReadinessPO(readiness, { persona, engineerBody })` emits the PO layer HTML: two equal-height VerdictCards (intent-complete and ready-to-build) with the chain term muted beside each plain label; one QuestionCard group per source span sourced from `toQuestions(readiness)`; a `data-rcf-empty="yes"` block that renders the verbatim `formatVerdictLines(readiness).intentComplete` string when `questions[]` is empty and both levels are ok (AC-18002-2); the Requirements-that-still-need-work table; and the For-engineers DocRow that wraps the engineer rendering, closed under productOwner / unstated and open under engineer, with the data preserved in the DOM in every register (AC-18002-3). Stamps `data-rcf-source="readiness.questions"` on the questions block when the real compute shape is live (AC-18002-1).
